combo1.title: Beyond the Brave: Grail Deck Fusion into Mechaba
combo1.description: Going first. Invocation - "Grail" takes one material from your hand or field and the other straight from your Deck, so Aleister the Invoker becomes Invoked Mechaba without a Link Monster to supply the LIGHT. Invocation stays in your hand as the Spell that Mechaba sends to negate. Next turn its Graveyard effect returns the Aleister that Grail banished, so you can run the turn again. Starting hand: Aleister the Invoker + Invocation - "Grail".

cards.name: Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice

steps.text: Normal Summon Aleister the Invoker.
Activate effect: Aleister the Invoker was Normal Summoned.
Add Invocation from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Invocation - "Grail". Aleister the Invoker on your field is the "Aleister" monster it needs. Choose its first effect: one material from your hand or field, one from your Deck.
Banish Aleister the Invoker from your field as the first material.
Banish Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice, a LIGHT monster, from your Deck as the second material.
Fusion Summon Invoked Mechaba ("Aleister the Invoker" + 1 LIGHT monster).
Invocation - "Grail" goes to the GY.
Your opponent's turn: they activate a Spell Card. Activate effect: Invoked Mechaba.
Send Invocation, which is also a Spell, from your hand to the GY. Mechaba negates the activation and banishes that card.
Your next turn: activate effect: Invocation in your GY. Shuffle it into your Deck.
Add the banished Aleister the Invoker to your hand.
Normal Summon Aleister the Invoker again.
Activate effect: Aleister the Invoker was Normal Summoned.
Add Invocation back to your hand. Mechaba is still on the field.

combo2.title: Beyond the Brave: Reminiscent and Grail into an Opponent's-Turn De Anima
combo2.description: Going first. Grail turns Aleister the Reminiscent and a LIGHT monster from your Deck into Invoked Baybarron, which adds Gamma Summon. On your opponent's turn, Invocation - "Sword" uses Baybarron and the Reminiscent that Grail banished to Fusion Summon Invoked De Anima, which destroys their Extra Deck monsters. Gamma Summon then adds Mechaba until the End Phase, and when Mechaba is banished, Gamma Summon's GY effect brings Baybarron back. Baybarron can do that because Grail properly Fusion Summoned it. Starting hand: Aleister the Reminiscent + Invocation - "Grail".

cards.name: Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice

steps.text: Normal Summon Aleister the Reminiscent.
Activate effect: Aleister the Reminiscent was Normal Summoned.
Banish Invoked Magellanica from your Extra Deck. It has no effect, so you lose nothing.
Add Invocation - "Sword" from your Deck to your hand. Sword names "Invocation" in its text, so Reminiscent can get it.
Activate Invocation - "Grail". Aleister the Reminiscent on your field meets its condition. Choose its first effect.
Banish Aleister the Reminiscent from your field as the first material.
Banish Virakam, a LIGHT monster, from your Deck as the second material.
Fusion Summon Invoked Baybarron (1 "Aleister" monster + 1 LIGHT or EARTH monster).
Invocation - "Grail" goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Invoked Baybarron was Special Summoned. Skip the optional banish from either GY; there's nothing worth taking yet.
Add Gamma Summon from your Deck to your hand.
Set Invocation - "Sword".
Set Gamma Summon, then end your turn. Baybarron stays on the field to be De Anima's Extra Deck material.
Your opponent's turn, after they Special Summon from their Extra Deck: activate Invocation - "Sword".
Send Invoked Baybarron from your field to the GY as the material that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.
Return Aleister the Reminiscent from your banishment to the GY as the "Aleister" material.
Fusion Summon Invoked De Anima (1 "Aleister" monster + 1 monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck).
Invocation - "Sword" goes to the GY.

Activate effect: Invoked De Anima was Special Summoned. Destroy all monsters your opponent controls that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck. If their threat is in the backrow instead, destroy all their Spells and Traps.
Activate Gamma Summon.
Banish Invoked Baybarron from your GY as the cost.
Special Summon Invoked Mechaba from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Mechaba is banished during the End Phase.
Gamma Summon goes to the GY.
End Phase: Mechaba is banished face-up.
Activate effect: Gamma Summon in your GY. Banish it.
Special Summon Invoked Baybarron from your banishment. Mechaba can't be picked instead, because it was never properly summoned.

combo3.title: Beyond the Brave: Going Second with Meltdown and Grail
combo3.description: Going second into a board built on Extra Deck monsters. Magical Meltdown adds Aleister the Invoker. Grail's second effect banishes Aleister together with your opponent's best face-up Extra Deck monster to Fusion Summon Invoked De Anima. The banish doesn't target and doesn't destroy. De Anima's summon effect then destroys the rest of their Extra Deck monsters, or all their Spells and Traps. The line uses two cards and never touches your GY. Starting hand: Magical Meltdown + Invocation - "Grail".

steps.text: Activate Magical Meltdown.
Magical Meltdown's activation adds Aleister the Invoker from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Aleister the Invoker.
Activate effect: Aleister the Invoker was Normal Summoned.
Add Invocation from your Deck to your hand for a later turn.
Activate Invocation - "Grail" and choose its second effect. With Magical Meltdown on the field, this activation can't be negated.
Banish Aleister the Invoker from your field as the first material.

Fusion Summon Invoked De Anima. The second material is your opponent's strongest face-up monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck. It's banished as material, so it isn't targeted or destroyed. Magical Meltdown also stops your opponent from activating cards or effects when De Anima is Fusion Summoned.
Invocation - "Grail" goes to the GY.

Activate effect: Invoked De Anima was Special Summoned. Destroy every other monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, or all their Spells and Traps if those are the bigger threat.
Battle Phase: attack with De Anima's 2900 ATK.
